latestArticle.headline: Brave H.C. Falls 7–1 to Zamboner Crew, Turns Attention to Next Challenge
latestArticle.dek: Official final: Brave H.C. 1, Zamboner Crew 7.
paragraphs: Brave H.C. found the net in the opening period but could not add another, falling 7–1 to Zamboner Crew on October 18.
Keith Pearsoll scored the club’s only goal in the opening period, with Alex Pagnotta and Stephane Saindon collecting the assists.
Zamboner Crew led 2–1 after the first period, then added 3 in the second and 2 in the third. Brave H.C. did not score again. Dev Leong was listed in goal for Brave H.C.
The result leaves Brave H.C. at 0–4 through 4 games, with 6 goals scored and 19 allowed.
Next up is Big Bastones on Sunday, October 25 at 6:15 pm ET, at Vaughan Sports Village - A Rink.
